title: panopsis rubescens
intro: Panopsis rubescens, commonly known as Western Pasque Flower, is a perennial plant species native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Panopsis rubescens include wound healing, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressive effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
